text:
Anya: Heads-up — seeing p99 tail latency regressions when serving AWQ weight-only INT8 (group=32) with FP8 activations on our 8xA100 pool. Baseline GPTQ/FP16 was stable. Repro script in thread.
Marc: link to repro pls? :eyes:
Anya: paste run and perf snippet:
```
./repro.sh --model redwood/gpt-small-awq --group-size 32 --activations=fp8 --batch=8 --kv-cache=on
throughput: 980 tok/s
p50: 18ms p95: 42ms p99: 210ms (baseline fp16 p99 170ms)
cpu memcpy spikes when kv hit
```
Devon: quick glance — kernel-chooser trace shows fallback to serial unpack path on hot requests: `chosen_kernel: awq_pack_unpk_serial`
Also saw `kv_hotpath: true` and repeated memcpy calls.
Sreja: group=32 + pack-stride mismatch can cause noncontiguous packing. What pack stride and buffer flags used?
Anya: pack-stride=64 (default), pack-contiguous=false. Profiler sample:
```
profiler top:
  memcpy: 46.1% (hot path)
  dequantize_awq: 24.7%
  pack_unpack: 14.9%
  matmul_fp8_fused: 8.3%
```
Kevin: try forcing kernel selector to prefer vectorized unpack path, and test with `--pack-contiguous`. Set `KERNEL_POLICY=prefer-vector` for bisection. Also try running with KV cache off to see if memcpy is from kv copies.
Anya: forced vectorized -> p99 dropped from 210ms -> 172ms (~18% improvement) but steady-state throughput dropped ~6%. Disabling KV cache reduced memcpy by half but cold-start p50 jumped. Numbers:
```
vector_policy p99: 172ms throughput: 920 tok/s
kv-off p99: 160ms throughput: 880 tok/s cold-start p50: 38ms
```
Devon: sounds like a tradeoff: vectorized kernel reduces unpack cost but might increase per-token compute or worse batching efficiency. Could be an extra dequant->requant introduced in the FP8 path for some fused ops. Check kernel trace for `dequantize -> quantize` sequence.
Marc: can we bisect calibration data? If calibration changed scales it might shift memory layout or kernel choice heuristics.
Anya: started bisect job `bisect/awq-calib-214` (job id 3482). Also kicked perf-bot to collect aggregated flamegraphs.
perf-bot: perf-bot: flamegraph uploaded -> https://perf.internal/fg/3482  top symbols: memcpy(45%), dequantize_awq(25%), pack_unpack(15%) :bar_chart:
Sreja: memcpy 45% suggests packing produced noncontiguous slices requiring many small copies. Try `--pack-contiguous` and reduce pack-stride to 32. Also run with `--coalesce-kv-copies` feature flag if available.
Anya: kicking off `--pack-contiguous --pack-stride=32 --coalesce-kv-copies` run now, ETA ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kevin: also capture kernel-selection table dumped via `--dump-ks /tmp/ks_table.json` so we can diff which kernels are chosen per sequence length/batch.
Anya: will dump and attach results when done.
Devon: if coalesce helps, we should add heuristic: when group-size >= 32 and activations=fp8, prefer contiguous packing and stricter vectorized kernel match. Might also tune batching heuristics so small batches avoid KG cache copy thrash.
Marc: assign follow-ups: Anya -> finish bisect and attach ks_table + flamegraphs; Devon -> prototype vectorized-fallback-opt; Sreja -> run pack-contiguous sweep; Kevin -> add experiment flags in infra.
Anya: ack. Posting updates here once runs complete. Thanks everyone :pray:
